messages:
Kai L: Heads-up: VeloBank onboarding stuck at payment method step. Customer sees "payment failed" when adding card; they're blocked from finishing admin setup. Renewal in 28 days, marking for CS escalation.
Meera P: Are they on Hosted or Dedicated? Billing contact?
Kai L: Hosted. Billing contact is finance@velobank.com. Ticket #6789 with logs: https://tickets.internal/6789. Error: `payment_processor.timeout`.
Ben T: Quick look shows our payment webhook to Stripe times out intermittently - 504. Repro 2/4 attempts.
Rina H: Can we allow them to complete onboarding without payment (temp grace) so admins can finish setup? We need to avoid a stalled kickoff.
Ben T: Support idea: create a 7-day trial grace override flag for org `velobank-prod` to bypass payment enforcement. Ops approval needed.
Meera P: Proposed comms and triage:
- CS owner: Meera P (primary to exec + billing)
- Support owner: Ben T (ticket & logs)
- Ops: enable `payment_grace` flag for 7 days for velobank-prod
- AM (Kai): prepare renewal outreach + goodwill credit if onboarding delayed
Agree?
ops-bot: Action queued: enable feature `payment_grace` for org `velobank-prod` duration 7d. Request ID rg-5591.
Ben T: Repro steps in ticket: `POST /orgs/velobank/pay` -> 504 from payment gateway. I'm adding retries + fallback to async charge; ETA ~4h for patch.
Meera P: Action items (owners):
- Kai L: reach out to finance@velobank.com with empathy + next steps (today)
- ops: expedite rg-5591 (ASAP)
- Ben T: deploy fallback async charge (4h)
- Meera P: schedule admin enablement call tomorrow 11am PT
Kai L: I'll send the outreach and include temporary grace details. Noted renewal risk (~$95k ARR); mark P1.
ops-bot: Request rg-5591 completed: `payment_grace` enabled for velobank-prod by ops-user at 2025-02-14T09:12:00Z.
Ben T: Fallback async charge deployed to prod; verified invites and admin flows work. Closing loop with customer.
Meera P: Thanks all. I'll send renewal note with an offer to waive first month if go-live delayed. Keeping thread open for customer reply
